item.title: Mykonos Secures Additional Desalinated Water to Combat Seasonal Shortages
item.description: Mykonos Municipality contracts for 290,000 m³ of additional desalinated water to prevent summer shortages, launching a temporary unit in Ano Mera by May 2026 in a €539,400 "water as a service" deal. item.title: Italian Olive Oil Market Enters Redistribution Phase, Creating Opportunities and Challenges for Greek Producers
item.description: The Italian olive oil market is entering a redistribution phase, offering Greek producers opportunities amid challenges. While Greece maintains strong exports to Italy, the reliance on bulk sales allows Italian brands to capture significant added value, highlighting the need for greater Greek branding efforts.
